data.name: JoyWorld Remastered (조이월드 리마스터)
data.detailed_description:
⚠️ Must Read Before Purchase: The Authentic Remaster of (Market Play 3) by the Original Creator! This is the official remastered version developed directly by pOnStudio, the original creator who built the very first classic "Market Play" game. Please note that this game is fundamentally different from other modified versions or unofficial series created by third parties or other companies. This is the only authentic successor that inherits and expands upon the original developer's unique systems and core essence. Designed specifically for those who cherish the atmosphere and dedicated craftsmanship of the original work, please verify that this is the official work of the original creator before making your purchase.

Relive the Nostalgia! Welcome to 'JoyWorld Remastered'!

The legendary classic flash game "Market Play," which brought warm memories to so many, finally returns in a fully completed, official remastered version by its original developer! 'JoyWorld Remastered' preserves the charming, nostalgic emotional style of the original while introducing beautifully polished visuals and deeper game systems, offering an unforgettable adventure for both returning fans and newcomers.

🎮 Core Gameplay & Features

  • Dynamic Economy & Trading: Engage in buying and selling a vast variety of goods across the market. Manage your resources wisely and develop your own strategies to grow your wealth.

  • Immersive Mini-Games: Enjoy a wide range of fun and engaging mini-games. Put your skills to the test to earn currency and unlock exclusive in-game rewards.

  • Whimsical Story & Quests: Explore a uniquely reimagined world inspired by traditional folklore and fairy tales, filled with humor and charming twists. Complete requests from diverse NPCs to uncover the lore of JoyWorld!

  • Progression & Collection: Collect beautifully crafted items, equipment, and rare treasures in a cozy, hand-drawn art style to upgrade your character.

✨ What Makes JoyWorld Remastered Unique?

  • Charming Art & Captivating Sound: Features a meticulously designed UI, heartwarming item illustrations, and an enchanting original soundtrack that enhances the nostalgic atmosphere.

  • A Relaxing Experience for Everyone: A violence-free, wholesome simulation suitable for players of all ages. Dive into a cozy, delightful economic adventure with total peace of mind!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.33 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU that support Pixel Shader version 2.x or above
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
